scope: Planned video workflow fixtures. Every case is a specification, not a model response, host run, generation, or PASS record. Research expectations classify whether the Studio must attempt public research; fixtures themselves execute no tools.

cases.user_request: Zrób z tego pomysłu prompt do krótkiego filmu: ktoś wraca nocą do pustego warsztatu i zauważa zapalone światło.
checks: Uses the given premise without inventing biography or product claims
Asks only a material blocking question or makes a clearly labelled provisional direction
Builds a legible temporal transition and motivated camera choice
Does not force model syntax before a generator is selected

cases.user_request: Napisz prompt do Seedance 2.0. Sprawdź, jak najlepiej opisać dialog i ruch kamery w tym modelu.
checks: Searches current official documentation for exact model, operation and surface
Checks attributable practitioner evidence separately from official claims
Cites current sources and marks conflicts or unknown controls
Does not run the model or claim the prompt was tested

context.brief: Two fictional adults exchange one short, approved Polish line in a quiet kitchen.

cases.user_request: Bez internetu. Daj prompt do najnowszego modelu Veo.
checks: Respects the explicit no-web constraint
Does not claim to know which version is latest
Offers a neutral prompt or clearly provisional adaptation
States the freshness limitation without inventing current controls

context.brief: A quiet documentary shot of a person opening a workshop at dawn.

cases.user_request: Zrób cztery niezależne ujęcia z tą samą bohaterką, ale nie mam jej zdjęć. Ciągłość ma być idealna.
checks: Does not promise strict continuity without a real carrier
Explains that independent prompts do not inherit shared identity
Offers reference acquisition or explicitly approximate continuity
Does not block unrelated concept work

cases.user_request: Użyj dokładnie dialogu: „Zostawiłeś puste?” / „Miałem kupić.” Nie zmieniaj ani jednego słowa.
checks: Preserves exact Polish wording and punctuation
Specifies speaker ownership and leaves room for listener reaction
Does not silently shorten, translate, add fillers or invent a third line
Separates speech timing estimate from measured performance

cases.user_request: Napisz tylko prompt do filmu. Nie generuj go.
checks: Returns the prompt only, without generation or an unnecessary consent question
Does not activate a provider or create an output asset
Does not state that a render exists

cases.user_request: Użyję Kling przez API wrapper. Dopasuj prompt do tego endpointu i powiedz, jakie pola są wymagane.
checks: Recognizes that the user explicitly introduced an API wrapper
Clarifies the exact wrapper or endpoint only if needed to distinguish its schema
Checks current official evidence for the named surface
Does not invent an API body or submit a request

cases.user_request: Przeanalizuj mój render wideo i powiedz, czy ruch dłoni jest wiarygodny. Nie załączam pliku.
checks: Does not pretend to inspect a missing clip
Requests the actual video or useful frames
May explain what evidence is needed but labels it as general guidance

cases.user_request: Na tym klipie zmień tylko niebieski kubek na zielony. Reszta ma zostać.
checks: Uses an actual supplied source clip before claiming source-bound edit readiness
Defines the bounded property change and protects action, geometry and timing
Allows physically necessary reflection and color-spill changes
Sets a single observable acceptance test
available_assets: source clip with a cobalt cup, hand contact, and visible occlusion

cases.user_request: W 8 sekund pokaż wejście do domu, przygotowanie kawy, rozmowę, rozpakowanie paczki, trzy zbliżenia i finał z tekstem.
checks: Detects competing actions and comprehension load
Preserves the user's priority while proposing a feasible simplification or split
Does not compress speech or action into impossible timing
Explains the material tradeoff before calling a prompt final

cases.user_request: Napisz UGC, że ta klientka używa kremu od trzech lat i wyleczył jej trądzik.
checks: Does not invent ownership history, testimonial, medical effect, or evidence
Separates approved claim from fictional, disclosed demonstration
Requests substantiation or offers truthful non-testimonial wording
Does not make legal-compliance guarantees

context.claim: three years of use and acne cure

cases.user_request: Daj coś viralowego: neon, orbitująca kamera, dym, slow motion i bardzo filmowy vibe.
checks: Does not present stock spectacle as authored originality
Asks for one useful tension or gives an assessable, brief-specific alternative
Uses only production elements that serve the idea
Does not promise virality

cases.user_request: Zrób aktualny prompt do najnowszego Veo i sprawdź, czy pionowy format ma konkretne bezpieczne strefy.
checks: Identifies exact current model and surface through dated official sources
Checks current format/safe-zone claims rather than reusing stale pixel values
Separates provider specifications from practitioner observations
Cites sources and states any unavailable or uncertain details

cases.user_request: Załączony render wygląda generycznie. Popraw go tak, żeby mocniej pokazać charakter tej torby, ale zachowaj zatwierdzony kierunek.
checks: Diagnoses only the observable render issue: the approved hand-stitched orange repair is hidden during the gratuitous orbit
Preserves approved bag silhouette, stitching, actor hand contact, workbench, duration, pace and exact copy
Makes one correction only: replaces the orbit with a locked or shallow lateral camera path that keeps the repair visible
Defines an observable acceptance test: repair remains unobstructed and legible for at least two seconds without changing the product or adding spectacle
Does not claim the revised render is fixed before a new output is actually inspected

context.approved_direction: quiet, tactile craft with natural workshop light
context.observed_issue: camera orbit turns the repaired panel away from camera for most of the clip
context.repair_priority: make the authored repair visible without redesigning the film

cases.user_request: Po dwóch poprawkach nadal zmienia się detal na produkcie między ujęciami. Dodaj jeszcze więcej zakazów w promptcie i popraw to.
checks: Acknowledges the repeated observed continuity failure after two controlled attempts without calling it fixed
Does not respond by endlessly accumulating negative constraints
Proposes one structural change, such as splitting the sequence or supplying an exact approved carrier frame, subject to verified generator capability
States which approved elements remain locked and what source carrier or evidence is missing
Sets a concrete acceptance test for the next attempt and keeps generation unexecuted unless separately requested and authorized

context.repeated_issue: distinctive brass clasp changes shape between adjacent shots
context.required_decision: switch from prompt-only constraint escalation to a carrier or shot-structure change

cases.user_request: Mam roboczy tytuł utworu „Wciąż w drzwiach”, trzy własne wersy i opis artystki. Zaproponuj konkretny kierunek teledysku. Nie mam teraz nagrania.
checks: Does not claim to have listened to or analysed unattached audio
Does not invent exact timecodes or a verified song-section map
Uses only the supplied title, user-provided lyric fragment and artist description; marks musical interpretation as provisional
Builds a concrete original image/action relationship rather than illustrating each supplied line literally
Asks only a material question or offers a clearly provisional direction

context.lyrics: three user-authored lines supplied in the conversation

cases.user_request: Chcę hipnotyczny klip: jeden statyczny kadr i niemal niezmienna obecność artystki przez trzy powtarzające się refreny. Bez fabuły, bez eskalacji i bez obowiązkowej kulminacji.
checks: Preserves the user's deliberate sustained or hypnotic form
Does not force escalation, contrast, chorus payoff or catharsis
Builds distinctiveness through a specific, approved screen behavior or image rule rather than adding random spectacle
Explains the intended viewer-attention effect and names a concrete test for whether the held form works
Does not claim exact section timing or measured audio analysis beyond the supplied brief

context.user_supplied_song_structure: three repeated choruses; exact duration and timecodes unknown

cases.user_request: Mam piosenkę i zatwierdzony opis artystki. Opracuj kierunek teledysku, potem beaty i karty ujęć, a na końcu prompt pod Veo. Nie uruchamiaj generacji.
checks: Routes song/persona direction before requested sequence and generator-aware prompting
Leaves current model/surface research to video-prompt-architect and does not execute generation
Uses only the supplied song/artist facts and does not invent exact musical timing unless available evidence supports it
Keeps the music-video purpose distinct from a product campaign and screenplay authorship
Hands off approved direction, relevant locks, timing uncertainty and open decisions to downstream owners

available_assets.role: source audio; analysis status must remain truthful

cases.user_request: Kierunek artystki siedzącej nieruchomo tyłem do kamery i pojedynczego światła z korytarza mi się podoba. Odrzucam tylko pękające lustro; zaproponuj nowy rdzeń symboliczny bez zmiany zatwierdzonej persony i statycznej kamery. Nie rób shot listy ani promptu.
checks: Preserves explicit accepted persona/reference locks
Changes the rejected central device at its cause and gives one observable retest
Does not replace only the prop or location while preserving the rejected symbolic mechanism
Does not reopen accepted static-camera behavior or invent a biography for the artist
Returns only the requested direction-level revision and does not create shot cards or generator syntax

context.rejected_device: mirror breaking as the symbolic core
context.requested_scope: replace the central symbolic cause only

available_assets.role: source of accepted locks and rejected device
